4.title: other pronouns

questions.stem: I don't like this book. Can you show me _____ one?
Two of them are here, _____ are in the room.
I have three books. One is here, _____ two are there.
Some students are singing, _____ are dancing.
This pencil is broken. Do you have _____?
There are 20 students in the class. 10 are boys, _____ are girls.

cloze.passage: I have two pencils. One is broken, _____ works well. Some people are here, _____ are outside.

5.title: irregular verbs past tense
5.topic: irregular verbs - 不规则动词过去式
5.rule: go-went, eat-ate, see-saw, buy-bought, write-wrote, tell-told

questions.stem: I _____ a letter to my friend.
She _____ me a story last week.

cloze.passage: Yesterday I _____ (go) to the park. I _____ (see) many birds. I _____ (buy) some bread.

6.title: irregular verbs continued
6.rule: leave-left, show-showed, ride-rode-ridden, write-wrote-written, blow-blew, see-saw-seen

questions.stem: She _____ her keys on the table and forgot about them.

By the time we arrived, she had already _____ the letter.

cloze.passage: Last weekend, my friend Tom _____ me to his farm. We _____ horses and fed the animals. Before we left, he _____ us some fresh vegetables.
